purchase-hold-placed.subject: Checkout paused for a buyer
purchase-hold-placed.title: A purchase hold was placed
purchase-hold-placed.summary: A buyer cancelled or let expire several unpaid orders, so their checkout is paused until {{until}}. Every cancellation was processed normally; nothing is blocked except placing a new order. The pause ends by itself; place a manual hold on the account to keep it longer.
